B06C059.summary: Stung by Duryodhana's taunts, Bhishma charges into the Pandava army, slaughtering their warriors so swiftly that he seems to be everywhere at once, and the Pandava host breaks. Krishna urges Arjuna to strike Bhishma, and their duel leaves Krishna and Arjuna pierced by arrows. Krishna leaps down with his discus to kill Bhishma, who invites the blow, but Arjuna holds Krishna back, and then Arjuna unleashes the Indra weapon, making a river of blood, until the Kauravas withdraw at nightfall lamenting their losses.

scenes.B06C059S01: Bhishma storms the Pandava army, Krishna and Arjuna face him in a duel, Arjuna holds back Krishna's attack on Bhishma, and Arjuna's Indra weapon brings carnage until nightfall.

shots.B06C059S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks what Bhishma did against the Pandavas after his dreadful vow in battle, and what the Panchalas did in response.
shots.B06C059S01H02: Sanjaya describes Bhishma's charge through the Pandava army with arrows that cut down warriors and make him seem multiplied, the Pandava rout, Krishna urging Arjuna to strike Bhishma, their arrowy duel in which Krishna's discus is raised and Arjuna holds him back and vows to fight, Arjuna's Indra weapon that fills the field with carnage and a river of blood, and the Kaurava withdrawal at nightfall with praise of Arjuna's feat.

B06C060.summary: On the next morning Bhishma leads the Kaurava army forward, surrounded by Drona, Duryodhana, Jayadratha and other princes, against Arjuna's array. The two sides clash amid a storm of dust, conches and falling warriors. Bhishma then turns on Arjuna, and their arrowy single combat is watched by both armies as Abhimanyu charges deep into the Kaurava host.

scenes.B06C060S01: The third day opens with Bhishma leading the Kaurava army against Arjuna, the armies clash, and Bhishma and Arjuna duel while Abhimanyu attacks the Kaurava ranks.

shots.B06C060S01H01: Sanjaya describes Bhishma advancing with the Kaurava princes around him, the glittering banners and elephants, Arjuna's array with Krishna as charioteer, the blare of drums and conches, and the clash in which the sky is covered with dust and warriors, horsemen and elephants fall in heaps.
shots.B06C060S01H02: Bhishma turns to attack Arjuna, Abhimanyu charges into the Kaurava host in the meantime, and Arjuna answers Bhishma's arrows with a shower of his own while both armies watch the single combat between the two champions.

B06C061.summary: Abhimanyu fights alone against Drona's son, Bhurisravas, Chitrasena and other warriors, and the Kaurava princes surround him. Dhrishtadyumna comes to his rescue, and in a duel Dhrishtadyumna kills Samyamani's son with a mace, provoking Samyamani to attack Dhrishtadyumna in turn. Salya joins the attack on Dhrishtadyumna, and a new round of fighting begins.

scenes.B06C061S01: Abhimanyu battles the Kaurava princes, Dhrishtadyumna rescues him, Samyamani's son is killed, and Samyamani and Salya attack Dhrishtadyumna.

shots.B06C061S01H01: Sanjaya describes Abhimanyu's stand against Drona's son, Bhurisravas, Chitrasena and Samyamani's son, the Trigarta, Madra and Kekaya princes surrounding him and his father, Dhrishtadyumna's rescue, the duel in which Dhrishtadyumna's mace kills Samyamani's son, Samyamani's fierce attack on Dhrishtadyumna, and Salya striking Dhrishtadyumna in the chest.

B06C062.summary: Dhritarashtra, doubting that his sons can win, presses Sanjaya for news, and Sanjaya blames the war on Duryodhana's policy. He reports the fighting in which Bhima, after the Kaurava elephant division is massed against him, leaps down and smashes the elephants with his mace. The chapter shows the Pandava side pressing hard and the Kaurava line breaking.

scenes.B06C062S01: Dhritarashtra asks about the battle, and Sanjaya describes the clashes of Dhrishtadyumna, Abhimanyu and Salya, followed by Bhima's rampage against the Magadha elephants.

shots.B06C062S01H01: Dhritarashtra complains that Sanjaya always reports his side losing and asks how the Pandavas could be weakened.
shots.B06C062S01H02: Sanjaya blames Duryodhana for the evil and describes Dhrishtadyumna, Salya and Abhimanyu fighting, then Duryodhana's brothers and the Pandava warriors opposing each other in pairs, and finally Bhima's attack on the Magadha elephants.

B06C063.summary: Duryodhana orders his whole army to surround and kill Bhima, and Bhima holds the line like a shore against the sea. Bhima's mace destroys ranks of men, horses and chariots, and Bhishma advances against him. Satyaki pushes forward toward Bhishma, and Bhurisravas moves to block him.

scenes.B06C063S01: Duryodhana sends his army against Bhima, who holds them off with his mace, and Satyaki then advances toward Bhishma until Bhurisravas steps in to fight him.

shots.B06C063S01H01: Sanjaya describes the great army charging Bhima at Duryodhana's order, Bhima's mace shattering the troops, and Satyaki's advance on Bhishma, ending with Bhurisravas rushing to fight Satyaki.

B06C064.summary: Satyaki and Bhurisravas duel while the two armies gather around them, and Bhima fights Duryodhana and his brothers. Bhima is wounded and swoons, then recovers and kills many of Dhritarashtra's sons, and Bhagadatta blinds him with arrows. Ghatotkacha attacks Bhagadatta's elephant, and Bhishma calls off the fight at nightfall, so both sides return to camp, Duryodhana grieving for his brothers.

scenes.B06C064S01: The duels of Satyaki and Bhurisravas and of Bhima and Duryodhana unfold, with Bhagadatta and Ghatotkacha joining, until Bhishma orders a withdrawal at nightfall and Duryodhana mourns.

shots.B06C064S01H01: A single long section covering the whole day: Bhurisravas and Satyaki trade arrows, Bhima fights Duryodhana, wounds and swoons, and recovers to kill many of the sons. Bhagadatta blinds Bhima with arrows, Ghatotkacha attacks Bhagadatta's elephant, Bhishma calls for a withdrawal at nightfall, the Pandavas return in triumph, and Duryodhana sits in grief.

B06C065.summary: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya why the Pandavas cannot be beaten, and Sanjaya answers that their righteousness protects them while his sons' cruelty weakens them. Duryodhana then asks Bhishma what makes the Pandavas invincible, and Bhishma says it is Krishna who guards them. To prove the point he recounts how Brahma praised Vishnu and asked him to take birth among men.

scenes.B06C065S01: Dhritarashtra questions Sanjaya, Sanjaya blames the sons' wickedness and Duryodhana's refusal to listen, Duryodhana asks Bhishma for the cause of Pandava victory, and Bhishma tells the story of Brahma's praise of Vishnu.

shots.B06C065S01H01: Dhritarashtra, fearful and puzzled, asks Sanjaya what gives the Pandavas their power and what his own side did after its retreat.
shots.B06C065S01H02: Sanjaya answers that the Pandavas fight by fair means and keep to righteousness, while the Kauravas acted cruelly and ignored the advice of their elders, and then introduces Duryodhana's question to Bhishma.
shots.B06C065S01H03: Duryodhana, grieved by his brothers' defeats, names his strongest warriors and asks what allows the Pandavas to keep beating them.
shots.B06C065S01H04: Bhishma urges peace with the Pandavas and says that Krishna protects them. He then begins a long tale of Brahma praising Vishnu and asking him to be born among men.
shots.B06C065S01H05: A section heading marking the start of the next section.

B06C066.summary: Vishnu agrees to Brahma's request and then vanishes, and Brahma tells the gods that Vasudeva must not be treated as a mere man. Bhishma says the sages taught him the same truth and that Krishna's presence brings righteousness and victory. He also says Dhritarashtra's sons are wrong to hate Krishna and Arjuna.

scenes.B06C066S01: Brahma's account of the god's agreement to be born among men and Bhishma's warning against despising Vasudeva, followed by Bhishma's explanation of why the Kauravas are wrong to oppose him.

shots.B06C066S01H01: Vishnu agrees to Brahma's request and disappears, and Brahma explains to the gods who Vasudeva is and why he must not be despised.
shots.B06C066S01H02: Bhishma says the sages taught him the same, then says Dhritarashtra's sons hate Krishna and Arjuna out of folly and that Krishna sustains the Pandavas.

B06C067.summary: Duryodhana asks Bhishma about Vasudeva's origin and greatness. Bhishma describes Vasudeva as the supreme being who created the elements, the gods, and the four social classes, and lists his deeds and titles. He ends by saying Yudhishthira has sought Krishna's protection.

scenes.B06C067S01: Duryodhana asks about Vasudeva, and Bhishma describes his creation of the world, his slaying of Madhu, and his role as protector, and says Yudhishthira has taken refuge in him.

shots.B06C067S01H01: Duryodhana asks Bhishma about Vasudeva's origin and glory.
shots.B06C067S01H02: Bhishma describes Vasudeva as the supreme god and recounts how he created the elements, the gods, the four classes of people, and the cycles of birth and death, then notes his slaying of Madhu and says Yudhishthira depends on him.

B06C068.summary: Bhishma recites a hymn that sages say Brahman himself composed, in which many seers name Vasudeva as the highest lord. Sanjaya reports that Duryodhana begins to respect Krishna and the Pandavas, and Bhishma again urges peace. Duryodhana then withdraws to his tent and lies down to sleep.

scenes.B06C068S01: Bhishma recites a hymn in which various seers praise Vasudeva, and Sanjaya reports Duryodhana's change of heart, Bhishma's renewed plea for peace, and Duryodhana's return to his tent.

shots.B06C068S01H01: Bhishma gives a hymn that sages say Brahman first spoke, listing the seers who praised Vasudeva under different titles, and ends by urging Duryodhana to turn his heart to Kesava.
shots.B06C068S01H02: Sanjaya says Duryodhana begins to honour Krishna and the Pandavas, and Bhishma again urges peace, telling him that the Pandavas are protected and that disregarding them will bring ruin. Duryodhana then goes back to his tent and lies down for the night.

B06C069.summary: At dawn the two armies line up, with Bhishma's Makara formation facing the Pandava Syena formation. Bhima and Arjuna both attack Bhishma, and Duryodhana urges Drona to break the Pandava line. Drona fights Satyaki, and Sikhandin's attack on Bhishma and Drona is held back, so the battle grows fierce on both sides.

scenes.B06C069S01: The armies form their battle arrays, Bhima and Arjuna attack Bhishma, Duryodhana asks Drona to break the Pandava line, and Drona and Sikhandin clash with their opponents.

shots.B06C069S01H01: Sanjaya describes the armies advancing in their formations, the Kaurava Makara array guarded by Bhishma, the Pandava Syena array with its named commanders in each part, Bhima and Arjuna attacking Bhishma, Duryodhana asking Drona for help, and the clashes of Drona with Satyaki and Sikhandin.

B06C070.summary: Bhishma fights fiercely to shield Duryodhana's sons from Bhima, and the general battle turns into a massive slaughter. Sanjaya describes the uproar, the piles of heads and limbs, and the rivers of blood. Duryodhana then advances with Bhishma at the front, and the Pandavas rush against Bhishma in response.

scenes.B06C070S01: Bhishma fights to protect the Kauravas from Bhima, Sanjaya describes the carnage across the field, and both armies press against Bhishma.

shots.B06C070S01H01: A long passage of Sanjaya's report: the uproar of the general battle, the countless fallen heads and bodies, the mixed slaughter of men and animals, and the closing move as Duryodhana leads the Kalingas forward behind Bhishma and the Pandavas charge against Bhishma.

B06C071.summary: Arjuna charges toward Bhishma, and his conch and bow strike fear into the Kaurava ranks, who seek Bhishma's protection. Many Kaurava allies move in to support Bhishma, and the battle spreads across the whole field, with heavy losses of elephants, chariots and men. Sanjaya describes omens, dust, and the way the fighting breaks apart into pairs of opponents.

scenes.B06C071S01: Arjuna drives at Bhishma, the Kaurava army falls back behind him, allied kings arrive, opposing warriors are matched in pairs, and the field is strewn with dead elephants, horses and chariots.

shots.B06C071S01H01: A long passage of Sanjaya's report: Arjuna's attack and his weapons, the Kaurava fear and retreat to Bhishma, the arrival of allied forces, the pairings of Pandava and Kaurava warriors, the dust and omens, and the mass destruction of elephants, chariots and horses.

B06C072.summary: The battle now spreads into many duels, with Sikhandin, Arjuna, Bhima, Yudhishthira, Satyaki and Ghatotkacha each facing an enemy leader. Bhishma holds back Bhima and cuts his bow, then kills Satyaki's charioteer so that Satyaki's horses bolt. Bhishma then wins the field against the Pandavas, while the Panchalas press on, and another round of combat begins.

scenes.B06C072S01: Duels spread across the field, Bhishma defeats Bhima's attack and wrecks Satyaki's chariot, and the Pandava forces attack again.

shots.B06C072S01H01: A long passage of Sanjaya's report: the pairings of warriors, the sun reaching midday, the splendour of the weapons and armour, Bhishma's contest with Bhima and Satyaki, the killing of Satyaki's charioteer, Bhishma's rout of the Pandavas, and the new round of fighting.

B06C073.summary: Several duels reach their peak in this chapter. Arjuna and Aswatthaman trade shots until Arjuna spares him out of respect, Bhima and Duryodhana wound each other, and Abhimanyu breaks through the Kaurava princes until Kripa carries Lakshmana away. The chapter ends with Bhishma slaughtering the Pandava troops and the field littered with bodies.

scenes.B06C073S01: Virata and Bhishma exchange arrows, Arjuna and Aswatthaman fight and Arjuna holds back, Bhima and Duryodhana trade hits, Abhimanyu fights Chitrasena and Lakshmana until Kripa carries Lakshmana away, and Bhishma's attacks leave the field strewn with bodies.

shots.B06C073S01H01: Sanjaya describes Virata's arrows against Bhishma, Aswatthaman's wounding of Arjuna and Arjuna's reply, Arjuna's decision to spare Aswatthaman out of respect for Drona, and Bhima's duel with Duryodhana, which ends with both sides bleeding.
shots.B06C073S01H02: Abhimanyu defeats Chitrasena and his fellow princes, fights Lakshmana until Kripa carries him away, and Bhishma then slaughters the Pandava troops until the field is covered with dead elephants and men.

B06C074.summary: Satyaki's duel with Bhurisravas grows into a fight between the two heroes, with Satyaki's sons attacking Bhurisravas and being killed one after another. Satyaki and Bhurisravas then continue on foot until Bhima and Duryodhana carry them off in their chariots. Meanwhile Arjuna destroys many Kaurava chariots, and at twilight Bhishma withdraws the army for the night.

scenes.B06C074S01: Satyaki duels Bhurisravas, Satyaki's sons die fighting him, Satyaki and Bhurisravas continue on foot until they are pulled away, and Arjuna's destruction of the Kaurava chariots ends the day as the armies withdraw at twilight.

shots.B06C074S01H01: Sanjaya describes Satyaki's archery against Duryodhana's chariots, his duel with Bhurisravas, the killing of Satyaki's sons, the fight on foot, and the rescue of both heroes by Bhima and Duryodhana.
shots.B06C074S01H02: Arjuna destroys twenty-five thousand Kaurava chariot-warriors as the sun goes down, and at twilight Bhishma calls off the battle and both armies go to their camps.

B06C075.summary: On the next morning both sides form their battle arrays, with Yudhishthira's Makara formation opposing Bhishma's crane formation. The armies clash across the whole field, and Drona wounds Bhima and kills his charioteer. Drona and Bhishma then drive back the Pandava troops, and the battle turns into a confused fight in which both sides suffer heavily.

scenes.B06C075S01: The two armies form their arrays, Yudhishthira's Makara meets Bhishma's crane, and the fighting is broken into many clashes until Drona and Bhishma drive the Pandavas back.

shots.B06C075S01H01: After a night's rest both armies prepare, and Yudhishthira orders Dhrishtadyumna to form the Makara array, with each part given its commander.
shots.B06C075S01H02: Bhishma answers with a crane array, naming the commanders in its beak, eyes, neck, wings and tail.
shots.B06C075S01H03: Sanjaya describes the battle beginning at sunrise, with each kind of fighter matched against another, Drona wounding Bhima and Bhima killing Drona's charioteer, and Drona and Bhishma then forcing the Srinjayas to flee.

B06C076.summary: Dhritarashtra praises his army for its discipline, skill, loyalty and the many great warriors who lead it, comparing it to a vast ocean. He still attributes its slaughter to fate, says that Vidura had warned against this war, and admits that Duryodhana would not listen. The chapter shows him looking back in regret and blaming destiny.

scenes.B06C076S01: Dhritarashtra describes the strength and loyalty of his army, its leaders, and its vast size, then wonders why such an army is being slaughtered and blames fate and his son's refusal to heed Vidura.

shots.B06C076S01H01: Dhritarashtra lists the army's virtues, compares it to an ocean, names its protectors, and then asks whether its slaughter is the work of destiny, recalling Vidura's advice and Duryodhana's refusal.

B06C077.summary: Sanjaya tells Dhritarashtra that the disaster is his own doing for allowing the dice match and the war, and then reports the battle. Bhima breaks into the Kaurava host and fights off Duryodhana's brothers, and Dhrishtadyumna rescues him after his charioteer Visoka leads him to the spot. Drona then routs the Pandavas, and the chapter ends with the Kaurava warriors cheering his success.

scenes.B06C077S01: Sanjaya blames the king for the war, Bhima fights through the Kaurava host and is rescued by Dhrishtadyumna, Duryodhana's forces turn on the rescuers, Drona neutralises the Pramohana weapon, and Drona drives the Pandava army into retreat.

shots.B06C077S01H01: Sanjaya tells Dhritarashtra that the calamity is his own fault for the dice match and the war, and that he must bear the consequences, and then promises to recount the battle.
shots.B06C077S01H02: Bhima breaks into the Kaurava line, faces Duryodhana's brothers and their allies, kills many warriors, and is surrounded until he takes up his mace and begins to fight on foot.
shots.B06C077S01H03: Dhrishtadyumna finds Bhima's empty chariot and his charioteer Visoka, and rushes to find Bhima. He rescues Bhima, Duryodhana rallies his brothers to attack Dhrishtadyumna, and a Pramohana weapon leaves the Kauravas unconscious. Drona revives them with a counter-weapon, drives back the Pandavas, and his men cheer.

B06C078.summary: Duryodhana recovers and returns to fight Bhima, but Bhima wounds him and his brothers. Yudhishthira then sends Abhimanyu and eleven other warriors after Bhima, and Dhritarashtra's sons retreat. The chapter shows the Pandavas taking control of this part of the battle.

scenes.B06C078S01: Duryodhana regains consciousness and fights Bhima, the brothers of Duryodhana attack Bhima, and Yudhishthira sends reinforcements led by Abhimanyu so that the sons withdraw.

shots.B06C078S01H01: Duryodhana and Bhima wound each other, the younger brothers attack Bhima and are beaten back, and Yudhishthira sends Abhimanyu and others to support Bhima, so that the sons of Dhritarashtra abandon the fight.

B06C079.summary: Abhimanyu and Bhima press into the Kaurava ranks in the afternoon, and Abhimanyu strikes down Vikarna's horses. Other Kaurava and Pandava warriors fight in close combat, while Bhishma and Arjuna make the field a sea of blood and corpses. The chapter ends with Sanjaya describing the fearlessness of both armies.

scenes.B06C079S01: Abhimanyu and Bhima attack the Kauravas in the afternoon, Abhimanyu defeats Vikarna and others, Bhishma and Arjuna carry out slaughter, and the field is described as a sea of blood.

shots.B06C079S01H01: Abhimanyu and Bhima press the Kauravas in the afternoon, Abhimanyu kills Vikarna's horses and wounds him, several duels follow, Bhishma slaughters the Pandava troops, and Arjuna's bowstring is heard on the right of the army.
shots.B06C079S01H02: Sanjaya describes the field as a sea of blood, with elephants as islands and chariots as boats, and notes that no warrior on either side is unwilling to fight.

B06C080.summary: At sunset Bhima confronts Duryodhana, vows to kill him to avenge the Pandavas' past humiliations, and shoots down his bow, horses, umbrella and standard. Kripa and Jayadratha rescue Duryodhana, and Abhimanyu and the Kaurava princes fight in a long series of duels. Bhishma then routs the Panchalas, and Yudhishthira embraces Bhima and Dhrishtadyumna at the end of the day.

scenes.B06C080S01: Bhima confronts Duryodhana with a long speech of accusation and wounds him, Kripa and Jayadratha rescue Duryodhana, Abhimanyu and the sons of Dhritarashtra clash in many duels, and Bhishma routs the Pandavas at sunset.

shots.B06C080S01H01: A long section covering the day's end: Bhima's accusations and attack on Duryodhana, the shooting down of Duryodhana's horses, umbrella and standard, the rescue of Duryodhana by Kripa and Jayadratha, Abhimanyu's duels with the sons and Satanika's killing of Dushkarna, Bhishma's rout of the Pandavas at sunset, and Yudhishthira's embrace of Bhima and Dhrishtadyumna.

B06C081.summary: The warriors on both sides rest, bandage their wounds and praise each other's feats. Duryodhana asks Bhishma for help, and Bhishma promises to fight to the end, admitting the Pandava allies are very strong. Duryodhana's army then marches out again, bright with banners and dust, looking like clouds at the end of an age.

scenes.B06C081S01: After resting, Duryodhana asks Bhishma how to win, Bhishma promises to fight hard, and Duryodhana's army advances in full array.

shots.B06C081S01H01: Duryodhana, wounded and anxious, asks Bhishma for victory. Bhishma admits the Pandava allies are formidable, pledges to fight to the limit, and the army advances with banners, dust and loud noise.

B06C082.summary: Bhishma lists the great kings and forces on the Kaurava side and says they could defeat the gods, while admitting the Pandavas have Krishna. He heals Duryodhana's wounds with an herb and arranges the army in a Mandala formation, while Yudhishthira answers with a Vajra array. Arjuna and Krishna charge the enemy kings, and Arjuna uses the Aindra weapon to beat back their volleys until Bhishma steps in to rescue the fleeing kings.

scenes.B06C082S01: Bhishma names the Kaurava allies and heals Duryodhana, sets up the Mandala array and the Pandava Vajra array, the armies pair off, and Arjuna and Krishna face the kings with the Aindra weapon until Bhishma rescues the fleeing warriors.

shots.B06C082S01H01: A long section covering the whole morning: Bhishma names the allies and says the Pandavas are hard to beat, heals Duryodhana, forms the Mandala array, Yudhishthira answers with the Vajra array, the pairings are made, and Arjuna and Krishna fight the kings, using the Aindra weapon until Bhishma rescues the retreating warriors.

B06C083.summary: Duryodhana gathers the kings to protect Bhishma, who charges toward Arjuna, and a series of duels follows. Drona kills Virata's son and steeds, Aswatthaman fights Sikhandin, Satyaki turns back Alamvusha with the Aindra weapon, and Kritavarman is beaten by Bhima. The chapter shows the Kaurava side holding its ground while many of its warriors are wounded.

scenes.B06C083S01: Duryodhana sends the kings to shield Bhishma as he meets Arjuna, and a series of single combats follows, including Drona against Virata, Aswatthaman against Sikhandin, Satyaki against Alamvusha, Dhrishtadyumna against Duryodhana, and Bhima against Kritavarman.

shots.B06C083S01H01: Sanjaya describes Duryodhana urging the kings to shield Bhishma as he charges toward Arjuna, and the two heroes come face to face.
shots.B06C083S01H02: Drona shoots down Virata's standard, bow, steeds and charioteer, then kills Virata's son Sankha, and Virata flees.
shots.B06C083S01H03: Aswatthaman kills Sikhandin's charioteer and steeds, Sikhandin fights on with a sword and is wounded, Satyaki takes him onto his chariot, and Satyaki uses the Aindra weapon against Alamvusha's illusions, driving him away.
shots.B06C083S01H04: Dhrishtadyumna wounds Duryodhana and kills his horses, and Sakuni rescues him by pulling him onto his own chariot.
shots.B06C083S01H05: Bhima destroys Kritavarman's horses, charioteer and standard, and Kritavarman retreats to another chariot.

B06C084.summary: Dhritarashtra complains that Sanjaya always describes the Pandavas as cheerful and unbeaten, and Sanjaya answers that his side's valour is undone by the Pandavas and that the disaster is the king's own doing. The chapter then reports a series of clashes: the Avanti brothers against Iravat, Ghatotkacha against Bhagadatta, and Sahadeva and Nakula against their uncle Salya.

scenes.B06C084S01: Dhritarashtra asks why his side always loses, Sanjaya blames the king's misconduct, and the battles of Iravat, Ghatotkacha, Bhagadatta and the twins against Salya are reported in turn.

shots.B06C084S01H01: Dhritarashtra says that Sanjaya never reports his side as cheerful or unbeaten, and that all of this must be Destiny.
shots.B06C084S01H02: Sanjaya says the valour of the Kaurava troops is wasted against the Pandavas and that the disaster was caused by the king and his sons.
shots.B06C084S01H03: Iravat kills the charioteer and steeds of the Avanti brothers Vinda and Anuvinda, and the Kaurava ranks are thrown into confusion.
shots.B06C084S01H04: Ghatotkacha fights Bhagadatta and his elephant, Bhagadatta destroys Ghatotkacha's horses, and Ghatotkacha flees from a duel he cannot win.
shots.B06C084S01H05: Salya fights the twins Nakula and Sahadeva, Sahadeva wounds Salya with a powerful arrow, and the Kauravas lose heart while the twins rejoice.

B06C085.summary: At midday Yudhishthira fights Srutayush and defeats him, and Kripa and Gautama fight Chekitana in a duel that leaves several warriors unconscious. Dhrishtaketu, Bhurisravas and Abhimanyu clash, and Arjuna charges Susarman and his allies, turning the field into a bloody confusion. The chapter ends with Arjuna taking on the kings who guard Bhishma.

scenes.B06C085S01: Yudhishthira defeats Srutayush, Kripa fights Chekitana, Dhrishtaketu and Bhurisravas clash, Abhimanyu faces several Kaurava warriors, and Arjuna moves against Susarman and his followers.

shots.B06C085S01H01: Yudhishthira and Srutayush exchange arrows, Yudhishthira kills Srutayush's steeds and charioteer, and Srutayush flees, and Yudhishthira begins slaughtering the Kaurava troops.
shots.B06C085S01H02: Kripa defeats Chekitana's charioteer and steeds, Chekitana fights with a mace and sword, and both he and Gautama are knocked out and carried off by their allies.
shots.B06C085S01H03: Bhurisravas defeats Dhrishtaketu and his charioteer, Abhimanyu fights several Kaurava warriors without killing them, and Arjuna charges Susarman with harsh words and is surrounded and showered with arrows.

B06C086.summary: Arjuna cuts down the bows and warriors of the Trigarta kings and others who try to block his path to Bhishma. Yudhishthira scolds Sikhandin for not keeping his vow to kill Bhishma, and Sikhandin takes up the fight again. Bhishma then defeats Yudhishthira, and the battle ends with Bhima and Chitrasena in a fierce struggle.

scenes.B06C086S01: Arjuna clears the way toward Bhishma, Yudhishthira rebukes Sikhandin for failing to keep his oath, Sikhandin resumes his attack, Bhishma defeats Yudhishthira, and Bhima and Chitrasena fight until Chitrasena's chariot is smashed.

shots.B06C086S01H01: Arjuna cuts down the bows of the Trigarta kings and others, clears the way toward Bhishma, and Sikhandin and the Pandava warriors come up to guard his chariot. Yudhishthira then scolds Sikhandin for failing to keep his vow, Sikhandin turns to Bhishma, and Bhishma's attacks on Yudhishthira and Bhima's fight with Chitrasena end the account.

B06C087.summary: Bhishma overwhelms Yudhishthira and then fights his way through the Pandava allies, but Bhishma passes Sikhandin by. The battle spreads across the field and then stops with the coming of dusk. Each army retires to its tents, where the fighters are tended and rest in the quiet of night.

scenes.B06C087S01: Bhishma routs Yudhishthira and the twins, the Pandavas gather their allies against him, Dhrishtadyumna and Satyaki fight the Kauravas, and at dusk both armies withdraw to their tents.

shots.B06C087S01H01: Bhishma overwhelms Yudhishthira and the twins, the Pandava allies gather around Bhishma, and the battle spreads across the field, with Dhrishtadyumna, Satyaki and the Avanti princes in combat.
shots.B06C087S01H02: A section heading marking the start of the next section.

B06C088.summary: At dawn both armies move out, and the Kaurava line is formed with Bhishma in front and Drona, Bhagadatta and Duryodhana behind. Yudhishthira answers with the Sringataka array, and then the armies clash in a fierce general battle. Bhishma charges into the Pandava ranks, and the Pandava warriors rush at him.

scenes.B06C088S01: Both armies march out, the Kauravas form a line led by Bhishma, Yudhishthira answers with the Sringataka array, and a fierce general battle begins with Bhishma charging the Pandavas.

shots.B06C088S01H01: The Kauravas advance in an array with Bhishma in front, and Yudhishthira answers with the Sringataka array, then the armies engage in a fierce general battle in which Bhishma charges the Pandavas and Dhrishtadyumna's warriors rush to meet him.

B06C089.summary: Bhima kills Bhishma's charioteer and then a group of Duryodhana's brothers, and Duryodhana, in grief, goes to Bhishma and accuses him of standing aside. Bhishma replies that he and Drona will not survive this battle, and that Bhima will kill whomever he targets, and urges Duryodhana to fight on. The chapter shows the Kaurava side losing heavily and the words of Vidura being recalled too late.

scenes.B06C089S01: Bhishma cuts down the Pandava forces until Bhima takes on Bhishma's charioteer and then kills Duryodhana's brothers one after another, Duryodhana accuses Bhishma, and Bhishma answers that the Kauravas cannot win.

shots.B06C089S01H01: A long section: Bhishma routs the Pandava forces, Bhima kills Bhishma's charioteer and then Sunabha and seven more of Duryodhana's brothers, the sons recall Vidura's warnings, and Duryodhana goes to Bhishma and laments that he is being left to suffer alone.
shots.B06C089S01H02: Bhishma, with tears in his eyes, replies that he and Drona will not survive, that Bhima will kill whomever he targets, and urges Duryodhana to fight on for heaven.

B06C090.summary: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya how his sons can keep being killed by one man, and Sanjaya answers that the king's refusal to listen to Vidura has brought this ruin. He then describes the midday battle, in which the Pandavas divide into three groups and attack Bhishma, Drona and the Kaurava ranks, and Bhima wrecks the Kaurava elephants. The field is left strewn with dead elephants, horses and men.

scenes.B06C090S01: Dhritarashtra asks about the losses, Sanjaya blames the king for ignoring Vidura, and the midday battle is described with the Pandavas attacking in three groups, Drona slaughtering the Srinjayas, and Bhima and the twins destroying elephants and horses.

shots.B06C090S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks how Bhishma, Drona and Kripa could have allowed his sons to be slain one by one, and blames fate and his son Duryodhana's refusal to heed warnings.
shots.B06C090S01H02: Sanjaya says Vidura's warnings have now come true, then describes the midday battle: the Pandavas split into three bodies, Drona kills the Srinjayas, Bhima destroys the Kaurava elephants, the twins attack the cavalry, and the field is strewn with dead animals and men.

B06C091.summary: Sakuni and Kritavarma lead Kaurava forces against the Pandavas, and Arjuna's son Iravat, born of a Naga princess, arrives with a large body of horses. Iravat fights off the six sons of Suvala and kills them, but Duryodhana sends the Rakshasa Alamvusha against him, and Alamvusha kills Iravat through illusion and deceit. Both armies then suffer heavy losses, and Drona and Bhishma are feared on the field.

scenes.B06C091S01: Sakuni and Kritavarma attack the Pandavas, Iravat leads his cavalry against the Kauravas, fights off the sons of Suvala, and is killed by Alamvusha after a long illusion-filled battle. The field is then filled with slaughter, Arjuna unknowingly kills Bhishma's guards, and Bhishma and Drona terrify the Pandavas.

shots.B06C091S01H01: A long section: Sakuni and Kritavarma advance, Iravat, Arjuna's son by a Naga princess, brings his horses into the field and crashes into the Kaurava cavalry, the six sons of Suvala charge and are killed one by one, and Duryodhana sends the Rakshasa Alamvusha, who fights Iravat with illusions until Iravat is beheaded.
shots.B06C091S01H02: Arjuna, not yet aware of his son's death, kills Bhishma's guards, Bhishma and Drona terrify the Pandava army, and the battle is so fierce that no side shows mercy.

B06C092.summary: After Iravat's death, Ghatotkacha roars in fury and attacks the Kaurava army with a band of Rakshasas. Duryodhana fights back, and Ghatotkacha tells him his wrongs against the Pandavas and Draupadi and vows to take revenge. The chapter opens the next phase of the battle between the two heroes.

scenes.B06C092S01: Dhritarashtra asks what the Pandavas did after Iravat's death, Sanjaya describes Ghatotkacha's roar and his assault on the Kaurava elephants, Duryodhana fights the Rakshasas, and Ghatotkacha accuses Duryodhana of his crimes.

shots.B06C092S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya to tell him what the Pandavas did when they heard of Iravat's death.
shots.B06C092S01H02: Sanjaya describes Ghatotkacha's roar that shakes the earth and the Kaurava troops, the Rakshasas attacking the elephant division of the Vangas, Duryodhana's counterattack and the slaughter of the Rakshasa leaders, and Ghatotkacha's speech accusing Duryodhana of the cruelty of the dice match and of Draupadi's humiliation before he attacks him with arrows.

B06C093.summary: Ghatotkacha hurls a huge dart that kills Bhagadatta's elephant, and Bhagadatta falls to the ground. Bhishma sends many Kaurava warriors to rescue Duryodhana, and Ghatotkacha defeats them one by one, wounding many of them, including Salya and Bhurisravas, while the Kaurava line is left in danger.

scenes.B06C093S01: Duryodhana endures Ghatotkacha's arrows, Ghatotkacha kills Bhagadatta's elephant with a dart, Bhishma sends a rescue force, and Ghatotkacha wounds or disables the rescuers one after another.

shots.B06C093S01H01: A long section: Duryodhana resists Ghatotkacha's arrows, Ghatotkacha kills Bhagadatta's elephant with a dart, Bhishma calls for a rescue, Ghatotkacha defeats the rescuers one by one, and Salya is left wounded.

B06C094.summary: Ghatotkacha rises into the sky after many Kaurava warriors surround him, and his roars echo across the field. Yudhishthira sends Bhima and a large body of warriors to rescue him, and the two sides clash in a bloody melee where even fathers and sons do not recognize one another. The chapter ends with the Kaurava army being driven back in confusion.

scenes.B06C094S01: Ghatotkacha rises into the sky, Yudhishthira sends Bhima and his allies to save Ghatotkacha, and the two sides fight in a chaotic, bloody battle that drives the Kaurava forces back.

shots.B06C094S01H01: A long section: Ghatotkacha is surrounded and flies up, Yudhishthira sends Bhima with his allies to rescue him, the armies fight in a chaotic and bloody melee, and the Dhritarashtra troops are driven back.

B06C095.summary: Duryodhana wounds Bhima, who then fights on foot against Duryodhana and Aswatthaman until Drona's warriors rush in. Drona faints from his wounds, and Nila, Ghatotkacha and Aswatthaman clash in turn. Ghatotkacha finally uses an illusion that convinces the Kaurava army it is being destroyed, and the Kauravas flee to their camp at sunset while the Pandavas celebrate.

scenes.B06C095S01: Duryodhana wounds Bhima, the Kaurava and Pandava warriors clash around them, Nila and Aswatthaman fight, Ghatotkacha uses an illusion that routs the Kauravas, and Sanjaya and Bhishma try in vain to hold the army together.

shots.B06C095S01H01: A long section: Duryodhana wounds Bhima, Ghatotkacha is enraged and Abhimanyu and the Pandava warriors rush at the king, Drona is wounded and sinks down on his chariot, Bhima on foot fights Duryodhana and Aswatthaman, Nila is wounded by Aswatthaman, and Ghatotkacha creates an illusion that routs the Kauravas. Sanjaya reports that Bhishma and he cry out to the fleeing troops, but they flee to their camp at sunset, and the Pandavas shout in triumph.

B06C096.summary: Duryodhana complains to Bhishma that Ghatotkacha has beaten his army and asks to be allowed to kill the Rakshasa himself. Bhishma tells him to fight the Pandava leaders instead and sends Bhagadatta against Ghatotkacha, whose elephant fights a fierce battle with the Pandava warriors. Bhagadatta wounds Bhima and breaks his chariot, Arjuna arrives to fight, and Bhima later tells Krishna and Arjuna how Iravat was killed.

scenes.B06C096S01: Duryodhana reports his defeat to Bhishma, Bhishma sends Bhagadatta to face Ghatotkacha, Bhagadatta's elephant battles the Pandava warriors and wounds Bhima, Arjuna joins the fight, and Bhima reports Iravat's death.

shots.B06C096S01H01: A long section: Duryodhana reports to Bhishma that Ghatotkacha has defeated him and asks to face the Rakshasa himself, Bhishma tells him to fight the Pandava leaders and sends Bhagadatta against Ghatotkacha, Bhagadatta's elephant battles the Pandava warriors, Bhagadatta wounds Bhima and breaks his chariot, Arjuna comes to the spot and fights, and Bhima tells Krishna and Arjuna how Iravat was killed.

B06C097.summary: Arjuna grieves over Iravat's death and says the war for wealth is a shameful slaughter of kinsmen, but he fights on out of duty. In the afternoon Bhima cuts down many of Dhritarashtra's sons, Drona fights him, and the Pandava and Kaurava warriors clash across the field in brutal close combat. The chapter ends with a long description of the field strewn with corpses and both armies withdrawing for the night.

scenes.B06C097S01: Arjuna laments the war, Bhima fights Drona and kills several of Dhritarashtra's sons, Bhishma and his allies go after Arjuna, Abhimanyu unseats Amvashta, the close fighting spreads, and both armies withdraw at night.

shots.B06C097S01H01: A long section: Arjuna grieves for Iravat and rebukes the war for wealth, then Krishna drives him into the battle. Bhima kills Vyudoroska, Kundalin and seven other sons, Drona shoots at Bhima who holds firm, the armies clash, and the night ends the fighting.
shots.B06C097S01H02: Bhishma, Bhagadatta and Gautama face Arjuna, Abhimanyu unseats Amvashta, and the close fighting leaves the field strewn with weapons, dead men and animals, until night and both armies withdraw.

B06C098.summary: Duryodhana, Sakuni, Dussasana and Karna plan how to defeat the Pandavas, and Karna advises that Bhishma should lay down his weapons so that Karna can fight. Duryodhana then goes to Bhishma's tent with a grand retinue and urges the old commander either to kill the Pandavas or to let Karna take over. Bhishma says nothing in reply, and the chapter sets up the quarrel that follows.

scenes.B06C098S01: Duryodhana and his counsellors plan the next day's fighting, Karna urges that Bhishma withdraw, and Duryodhana goes to Bhishma's tent in a grand procession and presses him to act, but Bhishma stays silent.

shots.B06C098S01H01: A long section: Duryodhana complains that his commanders do not resist the Pandavas, Karna advises that Bhishma lay down his weapons so Karna can fight, Duryodhana sends for his retinue, travels in procession to Bhishma's tent, and presses him to kill the Pandavas or let Karna fight. Bhishma stays silent.

B06C099.summary: Bhishma is hurt by Duryodhana's taunts but answers calmly, listing the Pandava feats that show their invincibility and saying Krishna protects them. He vows to kill the Somakas and Panchalas but will spare Sikhandin, who was born a woman. Duryodhana then orders his army to surround Bhishma and places him in the front of the battle, while Arjuna arranges for Sikhandin to stand before Bhishma.

scenes.B06C099S01: Bhishma answers Duryodhana's taunts with the story of the Pandavas' victories, pledges to spare Sikhandin, Duryodhana orders his army to protect Bhishma, and Arjuna places Sikhandin before Bhishma in the battle.

shots.B06C099S01H01: Bhishma, wounded by Duryodhana's words, answers calmly, cites the Pandava victories and Krishna's protection, promises to fight the Somakas and Panchalas, and says he will not kill Sikhandin. He then sends Duryodhana away and prepares for battle the next morning.
shots.B06C099S01H02: Duryodhana, sensing Bhishma's resolve to face Arjuna, insists that Bhishma must be protected, reports Bhishma's vow not to kill Sikhandin, and orders his brothers and others to surround Bhishma.
shots.B06C099S01H03: Duryodhana's army surrounds Bhishma and places him in the front. Arjuna then tells Dhrishtadyumna to put Sikhandin in front of Bhishma and promises to protect him.

B06C100.summary: Bhishma forms the Sarvatobhadra array, with Duryodhana in the middle and key commanders on each wing and in the rear. Yudhishthira answers with a Pandava array led by Bhima and the twins, with Sikhandin, Arjuna and Ghatotkacha in the middle. The two sides advance with trumpets and drums, and ominous signs such as falling meteors, jackals and dust heighten the sense of doom.

scenes.B06C100S01: Bhishma and Yudhishthira both form their arrays and command their forces, the two armies advance with loud noise, and omens of disaster appear in the sky and on the earth.

shots.B06C100S01H01: Bhishma marches out and forms the Sarvatobhadra array, names the commanders on each wing and in the rear, and places Duryodhana in the centre of the Kaurava line.
shots.B06C100S01H02: Yudhishthira forms the Pandava array with Bhima and the twins in front, Dhrishtadyumna, Virata and Satyaki in support, and Sikhandin, Arjuna, Ghatotkacha and others in the centre and rear.
shots.B06C100S01H03: The two armies advance with loud drums and conches, the sun grows dim, birds and jackals gather, meteors fall, and the animals weep, while the battle begins in an evil hour.

B06C101.summary: Abhimanyu charges into Duryodhana's army and routs many warriors, so that Duryodhana asks Alamvusha to stop him. Alamvusha first attacks Draupadi's five sons, kills their steeds and charioteers, and then fights Abhimanyu in a battle that is compared to a clash between Vritra and Vasava.

scenes.B06C101S01: Abhimanyu routs the Kaurava ranks, Duryodhana sends Alamvusha against him, Alamvusha defeats the five sons of Draupadi, and the chapter ends with Alamvusha and Abhimanyu clashing in a duel watched by both armies.

shots.B06C101S01H01: A long section: Abhimanyu routs the Kaurava ranks and is praised by the kings, Duryodhana asks Alamvusha to stop him, Alamvusha defeats the five sons of Draupadi, and the duel between Alamvusha and Abhimanyu begins.

B06C102.summary: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya for a full account of Abhimanyu's duel with Alamvusha and of the other Pandava warriors. Sanjaya describes the duel in which Abhimanyu defeats Alamvusha's illusions with a solar weapon, and then Bhishma and the Kaurava army try to stop Abhimanyu, Arjuna comes to his son's aid, and Drona fights Arjuna.

scenes.B06C102S01: Dhritarashtra asks for a full account, Sanjaya describes Abhimanyu's duel with Alamvusha in which the illusions are overcome, and the battle then spreads to Bhishma, Arjuna, Kripa, Satyaki and Drona.

shots.B06C102S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya to describe in full how Alamvusha fought Abhimanyu and how the other Pandava warriors fought.
shots.B06C102S01H02: A long section: Abhimanyu and Alamvusha trade blows and illusions, Abhimanyu uses a solar weapon to dispel the darkness, Alamvusha flees, Abhimanyu grinds the Kaurava troops, Bhishma attacks him, Arjuna comes to his son's aid, Kripa, Satyaki and Drona's son clash, and Drona and Arjuna face each other at the end.

B06C103.summary: Dhritarashtra asks how Drona and Arjuna, who respect each other, came to fight, and Sanjaya explains that they fight without regard for kinship because a Kshatriya's duty requires it. The chapter follows Arjuna's battle with the Trigartas and Drona, including the clash of the Vayavya and Saila weapons, and then Bhima's rampage among the Kaurava elephants.

scenes.B06C103S01: Dhritarashtra asks how the two heroes came to fight, Sanjaya explains the duty of Kshatriyas, Arjuna defeats the Trigartas with the Vayavya weapon while Drona counters, and Bhima fights the Kaurava elephants with his mace.

shots.B06C103S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks how Drona and Arjuna, who are both dear to each other, could come to fight.
shots.B06C103S01H02: A long section: Sanjaya explains that Kshatriyas fight kin without regard, Arjuna and Drona exchange shots, Duryodhana sends Susarman against Drona, Arjuna routs the Trigartas with the Vayavya weapon until Drona answers with the Saila weapon, the Kaurava allies attack Arjuna, and Bhima kills many elephants with his mace until the Kaurava elephant division flees.

B06C104.summary: At midday Bhishma fights a fierce battle against Dhrishtadyumna, Virata, Drupada and Sikhandin, and he will not strike Sikhandin, who he regards as a woman. The general battle turns into a grim scene of chariots dragged across the field and a river of blood, and Duryodhana urges his commanders to fight without boasting. Sanjaya blames the war on Duryodhana's refusal to heed his advisers.

scenes.B06C104S01: The midday battle between Bhishma and the Somakas becomes general, with Bhishma sparing Sikhandin, the fighting spreading across the field, the river of blood described, and Duryodhana urging his men on.

shots.B06C104S01H01: A long section: Bhishma fights Dhrishtadyumna, Virata, Drupada and Sikhandin, sparing Sikhandin, the Pandava warriors rush at him, the general battle breaks out with the horrible sights of dead men and animals, the river of blood is described, and Duryodhana urges his commanders to fight. Sanjaya ends by blaming the war on the king.

B06C105.summary: Arjuna routs Susarman's forces and the Kaurava army falls back, but Duryodhana and Bhishma attack Arjuna. The Pandavas surround Bhishma to protect him, and many duels follow, with Satyaki and Bhishma exchanging darts. The battle resumes with both sides fighting fiercely as the chapter closes.

scenes.B06C105S01: Arjuna routs Susarman's men, Duryodhana leads a counterattack on Arjuna, the Pandavas gather around Bhishma and fight a series of duels including Satyaki's clash with Bhishma, and the battle resumes at full strength.

shots.B06C105S01H01: A long section: Arjuna routs Susarman's men, Duryodhana and Bhishma attack Arjuna, the Pandava warriors surround Bhishma to protect him, many duels follow, including Satyaki's attack on Kritavarman and Bhishma's duel with Satyaki, and both sides fight on fiercely at noon.
shots.B06C105S01H02: A section heading marking the start of the next section.

B06C106.summary: Duryodhana orders Dussasana to protect Bhishma, who is surrounded by the Pandavas, and sends Sakuni and his horsemen against Yudhishthira and the twins. The Pandavas cut down the Kaurava cavalry, and Duryodhana then sends Salya against Yudhishthira. Bhima rushes to his brother's side as the sun sinks.

scenes.B06C106S01: Duryodhana orders his brother to shield Bhishma, Sakuni's horsemen are destroyed by the Pandavas, Salya fights Yudhishthira, and Bhima hurries to his brother's aid as the sun sets.

shots.B06C106S01H01: A long section: Duryodhana tells Dussasana to protect Bhishma, Sakuni's horsemen and the extra cavalry charge the Pandavas and are cut down, Duryodhana sends Salya against Yudhishthira, Salya wounds several Pandavas, and Bhima comes to Yudhishthira's side at sunset.

B06C107.summary: Bhishma destroys the Pandava army in a relentless attack, and his followers and foes are cut down until the Pandavas break into flight. Arjuna, urged by Krishna to fight, charges Bhishma, and the two exchange shots until Krishna leaps from the chariot and rushes at Bhishma with a whip. Arjuna clings to Krishna and begs him to stop, Krishna returns to the chariot, and Bhishma's attacks drive the Pandavas back until nightfall.

scenes.B06C107S01: Bhishma routs the Pandava army, Krishna urges Arjuna to fight him, Arjuna and Bhishma duel, Krishna jumps down and rushes at Bhishma, Arjuna halts him, and Bhishma's shafts drive the Pandavas back until sunset.

shots.B06C107S01H01: A long section: Bhishma's shafts cut down the Pandava army, the Chedis, Kasis and other allies are destroyed, the field is strewn with wreckage, and the Pandava army breaks into flight.
shots.B06C107S01H02: Krishna reminds Arjuna of his vow to fight Bhishma, Arjuna agrees and charges. The two heroes duel, Bhishma breaks Arjuna's bows, and Krishna jumps down and rushes at Bhishma with a whip. Arjuna catches him and pleads with him to stop, Bhishma welcomes Krishna's attack, and Krishna goes back to the chariot. Bhishma keeps shooting until the sun sets, and both armies withdraw.

B06C108.summary: At nightfall Yudhishthira, despairing of defeating Bhishma, proposes to give up the fight, and Krishna offers to fight in his place. The Pandavas decide instead to go to Bhishma and ask how he can be beaten, and Bhishma explains that he will not fight someone who lays down weapons or a woman, so Arjuna must fight with Sikhandin before him. Arjuna is torn about killing his grandfather, but Krishna insists that the duty of a warrior requires it.

scenes.B06C108S01: The armies withdraw at dusk, Yudhishthira despairs at night and Krishna offers to fight, the Pandavas visit Bhishma's tent and ask how he can be beaten, and Bhishma explains the conditions under which he can be defeated.
scenes.B06C108S02: Arjuna refuses to fight his grandfather, Krishna urges him to fight as a Kshatriya must, and Arjuna proposes to place Sikhandin before Bhishma.

shots.B06C108S01H01: A long section: the armies withdraw at dusk, Bhishma is praised by the Kauravas, and the Pandavas take counsel at night. Yudhishthira, despairing, offers to go into exile, and Krishna offers to fight Bhishma himself.
shots.B06C108S01H02: Yudhishthira declines to ask Krishna to break his pledge, recalls that Bhishma promised to advise but not fight for the Pandavas, and proposes that they go to Bhishma and ask how he can be defeated.
shots.B06C108S01H03: Krishna agrees that the Pandavas should ask Bhishma. The brothers lay down their armour and visit his tent, where Bhishma welcomes them and offers to help.
shots.B06C108S01H04: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma how he can be defeated and says the grandsire's skill is unmatched.
shots.B06C108S01H05: Bhishma explains that he will not fight those who have thrown down their weapons, women, or others he will not strike, and that Sikhandin, who was once a woman, can stand before Arjuna, who alone with Krishna can defeat him.
shots.B06C108S02H01: Arjuna, grieved, tells Krishna he cannot fight his grandfather, recalling how he once sat on Bhishma's lap as a child, and says he will not fight him even if his army is destroyed.
shots.B06C108S02H02: Krishna answers that Arjuna must slay Bhishma as a Kshatriya's duty requires, and cites the teaching of Vrihaspati that even an honoured elder who comes as an enemy may be killed.
shots.B06C108S02H03: Arjuna proposes to place Sikhandin before Bhishma, since Bhishma will not strike him, and says he himself will hold back the other great warriors.
shots.B06C108S02H04: The Pandavas return to their tents with Krishna after their talk with Bhishma, and the chapter ends with them going to rest.

B06C109.summary: Dhritarashtra asks how Sikhandin and Bhishma met in battle, and Sanjaya describes the battle array on each side and the Pandava assault on Bhishma. On the tenth day Bhishma routs the Pandava warriors and breaks Sikhandin's division, then refuses to strike Sikhandin, who taunts him and wounds him. Arjuna urges Sikhandin to fight on and promises to hold back the Kaurava warriors.

scenes.B06C109S01: Dhritarashtra asks about Sikhandin and Bhishma, Sanjaya describes the battle arrays, Bhishma defeats the Pandava warriors on the tenth day, refuses to fight Sikhandin, Sikhandin taunts and wounds him, and Arjuna urges Sikhandin on.

shots.B06C109S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks how Sikhandin advanced against Bhishma and how Bhishma advanced against the Pandavas.
shots.B06C109S01H02: Sanjaya describes the Pandava array with Sikhandin in front, Bhima and Arjuna guarding his wheels, Yudhishthira and the others behind, and the Kaurava array with Bhishma at the head, Drona, Aswatthaman and others behind him. The two armies clash, and the Kaurava troops are beaten back.
shots.B06C109S01H03: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya to describe what Bhishma did when his army was struck by the Pandavas.
shots.B06C109S01H04: Sanjaya describes Bhishma's assault on the Pandavas, his showers of arrows, his destruction of the Pandava warriors, and on the tenth day his defeat of Sikhandin's division. Bhishma refuses to fight Sikhandin, who taunts him and wounds him.
shots.B06C109S01H05: Arjuna urges Sikhandin to attack Bhishma and promises to protect him and hold back the Kaurava warriors, including Drona, Kripa and Duryodhana.

B06C110.summary: Dhritarashtra asks how Sikhandin attacked Bhishma on the tenth day, and Sanjaya describes Bhishma destroying the Pandava forces. Arjuna then sweeps in, and Duryodhana, terrified, begs Bhishma for protection. Bhishma, reminding Duryodhana of his vow, vows to slay the Pandavas or die, and he wipes out vast numbers of their troops that day.

scenes.B06C110S01: Dhritarashtra asks about the tenth day, Sanjaya describes Arjuna's arrival and Duryodhana's plea, and Bhishma answers with a vow and a massive slaughter of Pandava troops.

shots.B06C110S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks how Sikhandin attacked Bhishma on the tenth day and whether Bhishma's bow or chariot was broken.
shots.B06C110S01H02: Sanjaya says that neither Bhishma's bow nor his chariot was harmed, that Bhishma was destroying the Pandava forces, and that the Pandavas could not defeat him.
shots.B06C110S01H03: Arjuna arrives and the Kaurava troops flee. Duryodhana, terrified, begs Bhishma to protect them. Bhishma reminds him of his vows, promises to slay the Pandavas or die, and destroys many Pandava troops, leaving the field to a fierce battle.

B06C111.summary: Arjuna urges Sikhandin to attack Bhishma, and the Pandava commanders rush to Bhishma's car while the Kaurava warriors go out to meet them. Dussasana blocks Arjuna, and the two fight a fierce duel in which Arjuna wounds Dussasana and then Duryodhana, who withdraws to Bhishma's car.

scenes.B06C111S01: Arjuna urges Sikhandin on, the Pandava and Kaurava warriors pair off across the field, Dussasana blocks Arjuna, and Arjuna wounds Dussasana and Duryodhana before Duryodhana retreats.

shots.B06C111S01H01: A long section: Arjuna urges Sikhandin to attack Bhishma and the Pandava commanders rush forward, the Kaurava warriors meet them in pairs, Dussasana holds back Arjuna, the two exchange wounds, and Arjuna wounds Duryodhana with many shafts until Duryodhana retreats to Bhishma's car.

B06C112.summary: The fighting around Bhishma spreads into many pairs of duels, including Satyaki against Alamvusha and Bhagadatta, and Kripa against Sahadeva. Kaurava warriors gather to kill Satyaki, while the Pandava and Kaurava princes all fight for control of Bhishma's position. The chapter describes the widespread clash of heroes that ends in Bhurisravas facing Bhima.

scenes.B06C112S01: Satyaki battles Alamvusha and Bhagadatta, Duryodhana orders the Kauravas to surround Satyaki, and a series of duels spreads across the field among Bhishma's guards and the Pandava warriors.

shots.B06C112S01H01: A long section: Satyaki fights Alamvusha and Bhagadatta, Duryodhana gathers cars to trap Satyaki, Sikhandin rushes at Bhishma, and a series of duels breaks out among the Pandava and Kaurava warriors, ending with Bhurisravas wounding Bhima.

B06C113.summary: Drona, watching omens of disaster in the sky and among the animals, tells his son Aswatthaman that Arjuna will attack Bhishma that day. He says Sikhandin is an ill omen, but Bhishma will not strike him, and he sends his son against Sikhandin and Bhima while he himself goes to meet Yudhishthira's forces. The chapter ends with Drona's orders for the day.

scenes.B06C113S01: Drona describes the bad omens he sees, warns that Arjuna will attack Bhishma and that Sikhandin is an ill omen, and sends his son Aswatthaman against Sikhandin and Bhima while he goes against Yudhishthira.

shots.B06C113S01H01: A long section: Drona lists the omens, including meteors, cries of birds and jackals, and trembling idols, predicts that Arjuna will attack Bhishma, notes Bhishma's vow not to slay Sikhandin, and tells his son to fight Sikhandin and Bhima while he himself goes against Yudhishthira.

B06C114.summary: Ten Kaurava warriors, led by Salya, Kripa, Bhagadatta and Jayadratha, attack Bhima together on Drona's orders. Bhima holds them off, wounds each of them, and cuts down their weapons, but he is wounded in turn. Arjuna then comes to help his brother, and Duryodhana sends Susarman with a large force to kill both Arjuna and Bhima.

scenes.B06C114S01: Ten Kaurava warriors attack Bhima, who wounds them all and defeats their projectiles, Arjuna arrives to help, and Duryodhana sends Susarman against both Pandava brothers.

shots.B06C114S01H01: A long section: the Kaurava warriors attack Bhima together, he wounds Salya, Kripa and Jayadratha, breaks their bows and kills their horses, Arjuna arrives with Sikhandin before him, and Duryodhana sends Susarman with the Trigartas against Arjuna and Bhima.

B06C115.summary: Arjuna and Bhima fight Susarman's forces and the Kaurava kings in a fierce battle that leaves many chariots, horses and elephants destroyed. Drona and the Magadha king join the fight against the brothers, and the battle turns general. Bhishma and Duryodhana advance on the Pandavas, Sikhandin rushes at Bhishma, and Dhrishtadyumna orders the Pandavas to attack him as the battle for Bhishma's fate begins.

scenes.B06C115S01: Arjuna and Bhima battle Susarman's Trigartas and the Kaurava kings, Drona and the Magadha king attack Bhima, Bhishma and Duryodhana advance, and Sikhandin and the Pandavas charge Bhishma.

shots.B06C115S01H01: A long section: Arjuna and Bhima battle Salya, Susarman and the other Kaurava kings, destroying chariots and men, Drona and Jayatsena engage Bhima, Bhishma and Duryodhana advance, Sikhandin rushes at Bhishma, and Dhrishtadyumna urges the Pandavas to attack him.

B06C116.summary: Dhritarashtra asks how Bhishma fought on the tenth day, and Sanjaya describes Bhishma's grief at the slaughter he has caused. Bhishma tells Yudhishthira that he no longer wishes to live and asks to be slain with Arjuna and Sikhandin leading the attack. The Pandavas take up the challenge, and both armies clash in a general battle that Sanjaya compares to a fight between hawks over meat.

scenes.B06C116S01: Dhritarashtra asks about Bhishma's fighting on the tenth day, Sanjaya describes Bhishma's resolve to be slain, Yudhishthira accepts and plans the attack, and both armies clash in a huge general battle.

shots.B06C116S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya to describe how Bhishma and the Kurus fought on the tenth day.
shots.B06C116S01H02: Sanjaya describes Bhishma's ten days of carnage, then his resolve to die, and his plea to Yudhishthira to strike him with Arjuna and Sikhandin in front. Yudhishthira vows to defeat Bhishma, the armies clash in a general battle, and the uproar and dust are described as a fight between hawks over meat.

B06C117.summary: The duels around Bhishma continue. Abhimanyu fights Duryodhana, Aswatthaman fights Satyaki, and Paurava and Dhrishtaketu fight to the point of falling together, while Bhima crushes the elephant division and Drona and Dhrishtadyumna trade heavy blows. Arjuna then pushes through the Kaurava warriors toward Bhishma, and Bhishma's arrows drive back the Pandava forces.

scenes.B06C117S01: Abhimanyu, Aswatthaman, Paurava and Dhrishtaketu, Chitrasena and Susarman, and Drona and Dhrishtadyumna all clash in duels across the field, while Bhima destroys the elephant division and Yudhishthira and Salya exchange blows.
scenes.B06C117S02: Arjuna pushes toward Bhishma, scattering the Kaurava warriors, while Bhishma fights back with his weapons and drives the Pandava army back.

shots.B06C117S01H01: A long section: Abhimanyu fights Duryodhana, Aswatthaman fights Satyaki, and Paurava and Dhrishtaketu wound each other until both fall. Paurava is carried off by Jayatsena and Dhrishtaketu by Sahadeva.
shots.B06C117S01H02: Chitrasena and Susarman exchange many arrows, each wounding the other.
shots.B06C117S01H03: Abhimanyu fights Vrihadvala, shooting down his bow and wounding him. The battle for Bhishma's sake is compared to the old fight between Vali and Vasava.
shots.B06C117S01H04: Bhima slaughters the elephant division, Yudhishthira fights Salya, and Jayadratha and Virata trade heavy wounds.
shots.B06C117S01H05: Drona and Dhrishtadyumna fight fiercely, Drona breaks Dhrishtadyumna's bow and deflects his mace and dart, and their duel is described as a fierce struggle for Bhishma's sake.
shots.B06C117S02H01: Arjuna charges toward Bhishma, scattering the Kaurava troops, and Sikhandin attacks Bhishma. Bhishma fights back with a blazing shower of arrows, slaughters the Somakas, and drives back the Pandava forces. Only Arjuna and Sikhandin dare to approach him.

B06C118.summary: Sikhandin attacks Bhishma with many arrows, but Bhishma will not strike him out of respect for his former sex. Arjuna urges Sikhandin on, and Dussasana holds back the Pandava warriors so that Bhishma is protected. The Kaurava army rallies and Arjuna scatters the Kaurava allies, defeats several leaders, and turns to Bhishma again until the armies are thrown into confusion.

scenes.B06C118S01: Sikhandin attacks Bhishma, Bhishma refuses to strike him, Arjuna urges Sikhandin on, Dussasana and Arjuna fight, and Duryodhana rallies his allies to face Arjuna. Arjuna scatters the Kaurava forces, and Bhishma confronts Arjuna until the armies are thrown into confusion.

shots.B06C118S01H01: Sikhandin strikes Bhishma with arrows, but Bhishma will not strike back, and Arjuna urges Sikhandin on. Dussasana fights Arjuna to protect Bhishma, Arjuna drives Dussasana back, and Sikhandin keeps shooting Bhishma, who accepts the arrows calmly while slaughtering the Pandavas.
shots.B06C118S01H02: Duryodhana calls on all his warriors to attack Arjuna, promising Bhishma's protection. The Kaurava allies rush at Arjuna, who scatters them, defeats Kripa, Salya, Dussasana, Vikarna and Vivinsati, and fills the field with dead men and animals. Bhishma then readies a celestial weapon against Arjuna, and Sikhandin rushes at Bhishma, forcing him to withdraw it.

B06C119.summary: The battle breaks into a chaotic melee in which the fighters no longer keep to their own kinds. Bhishma cuts down thousands of Pandava warriors, and Dhrishtadyumna urges the Somakas to attack him. Krishna then tells Arjuna to block Bhishma, and Arjuna and Sikhandin press their attack on the grandsire, who refuses to strike Sikhandin.

scenes.B06C119S01: The armies fight without order, Salya and the Kaurava warriors push back the Pandavas, Bhishma destroys thousands of their warriors, Dhrishtadyumna orders an attack on Bhishma, and Arjuna and Sikhandin move against him.

shots.B06C119S01H01: The two armies fight in a disordered melee in which warriors of different kinds fight each other, and all distinctions between the fighters disappear.
shots.B06C119S01H02: Salya, Kripa, Dussasana and Vikarna push back the Pandava army, Bhishma cuts down its warriors, and Arjuna fells many of the Kaurava elephants, while the Kaurava princes press forward to fight for Bhishma.
shots.B06C119S01H03: Dhrishtadyumna orders the Somakas to attack Bhishma, who destroys many of their warriors, including Satanika. Krishna tells Arjuna to block Bhishma, and Arjuna and the Pandava warriors rush at him. Bhishma refuses to strike Sikhandin out of regard for his former sex, and Sikhandin and Arjuna keep attacking him.

B06C120.summary: The Pandavas and Srinjayas gang up on Bhishma, and Arjuna and Sikhandin cut down his bows, but Bhishma keeps fighting. Bhishma concludes that he will die, and when he falls from his chariot at sunset he decides to wait on his bed of arrows until the sun turns north. The Kauravas despair, the Pandavas rejoice, and Bhishma waits in meditation.

scenes.B06C120S01: The Pandavas surround Bhishma, Arjuna and Sikhandin cut down his bows, Bhishma resolves to die, and when he falls at sunset he waits on his bed of arrows until the sun turns north.

shots.B06C120S01H01: A long section: the Pandavas and Srinjayas strike Bhishma from every side, and his body is pierced without pain. Arjuna and Sikhandin cut down his bows, and Bhishma decides to die at a favourable time, as the gods and sages approve. Duryodhana's allies attack Arjuna in his defence, Arjuna keeps shooting Bhishma's bows and armour, and at sunset falls from his chariot onto his bed of arrows. Swans appear, and Bhishma, who can choose his time of death, resolves to wait until the sun turns north.
shots.B06C120S01H02: The Kauravas grieve and are stunned, the Pandavas blow their conches and Bhima shouts in triumph, the soldiers on both sides lay down their arms, and the sages praise Bhishma while he sits in meditation, waiting.
shots.B06C120S01H03: A section heading marking the start of the next section.

B06C121.summary: Dhritarashtra laments that Bhishma has fallen, especially to Sikhandin, and asks what followed. Sanjaya describes the grief of the Kauravas, the news that reaches Drona, and the halt in the fighting as both armies come to Bhishma's bedside. Bhishma greets them and asks for a pillow, then rejects the soft cushions the kings bring and asks Arjuna for a proper one.

scenes.B06C121S01: Dhritarashtra mourns Bhishma's fall and asks what happened, Sanjaya describes the Kaurava grief, the halt in the fighting, the gathering of kings, and Bhishma's request for a pillow fit for a warrior.

shots.B06C121S01H01: Dhritarashtra laments that Bhishma, who was not slain even by Parashurama, has been killed by Sikhandin, and asks Sanjaya for the details.
shots.B06C121S01H02: Sanjaya describes Bhishma falling at sunset without touching the ground, the grief and shame of the Kauravas, the Pandava celebrations, and Dussasana telling Drona, who faints. Both armies then stop fighting and gather at Bhishma's bedside. Bhishma asks for a pillow, rejects the soft cushions the kings offer, and asks Arjuna for one.

B06C122.summary: Arjuna supports Bhishma's head with three arrows, and Bhishma praises him and says he will wait on his bed of arrows until the sun turns north before dying. He refuses the physicians, and the kings from both sides gather around him before returning to their tents for the night. Krishna then praises Yudhishthira for the victory, and Yudhishthira credits Krishna's protection.

scenes.B06C122S01: Arjuna props up Bhishma's head with arrows, Bhishma praises him, Bhishma refuses the physicians, the armies gather around him and then go to rest, and Krishna and Yudhishthira speak together about the victory.

shots.B06C122S01H01: Arjuna, reverent and tearful, asks Bhishma what to do. Bhishma asks for a pillow, Arjuna supports his head with three arrows, and Bhishma praises him and says he will wait until the sun turns north before dying. He asks for a ditch to be dug around him and orders the kings to end their hostility.
shots.B06C122S01H02: Bhishma refuses the physicians and asks that they be dismissed with gifts. The kings admire his steadfastness, the armies gather around him, and then they return to their tents in the evening, grieving.
shots.B06C122S01H03: Krishna tells Yudhishthira that the victory is due to his good fortune and that Bhishma has been brought down, and Yudhishthira credits Krishna's protection, to which Krishna replies with a smile.

B06C123.summary: The next morning the kings of both sides gather around Bhishma and bring him water, but he refuses ordinary drink. Arjuna makes a spring of cool water rise from the earth with a special arrow, and Bhishma praises him and urges Duryodhana to make peace before the bloodshed continues. Duryodhana refuses, and Bhishma turns to yoga while still in pain.

scenes.B06C123S01: The kings gather around Bhishma in the morning, Bhishma asks for water and then for Arjuna, Arjuna makes a spring rise, Bhishma praises him and urges Duryodhana to make peace, and Duryodhana refuses.

shots.B06C123S01H01: A long section: crowds of kings, women, children and spectators gather around Bhishma, and he asks for water but refuses it, saying he is no longer of the human world. He calls for Arjuna, who makes a spring rise from the earth with a special arrow. Bhishma praises Arjuna and urges Duryodhana to make peace with the Pandavas, pleading that the bloodshed end with his death, and then he falls silent and turns to yoga.
shots.B06C123S01H02: Sanjaya says that Duryodhana does not accept this advice, like a dying man refusing medicine.

B06C124.summary: Karna hears of Bhishma's fall and visits him on his bed of arrows. Bhishma embraces him, reveals that he is Kunti's son, and urges peace with the Pandavas, but Karna refuses to abandon Duryodhana and asks forgiveness for his past harsh words. Bhishma gives him leave to fight, Karna rides off, and the chapter closes the Bhishma Parva. The rest of the chapter is the translator's footnotes, mainly on variant readings and the sense of Gita verses.

shots.B06C124S01H01: Karna, hearing of Bhishma's fall, comes to him, and Bhishma embraces him, reveals that he is Kunti's son, and asks him to join the Pandavas and end the feud.
shots.B06C124S01H02: Karna replies that he knows his birth, that he cannot abandon Duryodhana, and that he will fight the Pandavas, asking Bhishma to forgive his past harsh words.
shots.B06C124S01H03: Bhishma gives Karna leave to fight, urging him to act without anger and noting that he himself tried for a long time to make peace.
shots.B06C124S01H04: After Karna salutes Bhishma and is forgiven, he mounts his chariot and rides towards Duryodhana's quarters.
shots.B06C124S01H05: A closing line marking the end of the Bhishma Parva.
